final: SELECT SUM(state_total) as sum_of_state_totals, AVG(invoice_count) as avg_invoices_per_state FROM (SELECT c.State, COUNT(*) as invoice_count, SUM(i.Total) as state_total FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceDate > '2010-06-22 00:00:00' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2012-06-26 00:00:00' GROUP BY c.State)
